title: A Part Sale is priced by the customer's Part Sales tier from the Part Sale side
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35, and Separate Part Sale pricing turned on with Part Sale Matrix Default Markup % 50.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10 on the Part Sale Matrix side.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for Part Sales in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tiers were set.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Part Sale 1.
  2. Add a part with category A and cost 100.00 to Part Sale 1.
  3. Point at the part's sell price.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part Sale 1 opens on its parts table.

Step 2:

  • The part's sell price reads $135.00: Part Sale Default $100.00 × 1.50 = $150.00 × 0.90 = $135.00.

Step 3:

  • The price details name tier A, matrix A's Part Sale Matrix side, the 10% off rule and Default's price $150.00.
